about: Fixed-seed regression set for `refkit bench --golden --label NAME`: every pipeline change is compared against the previous label's contact sheets before it is kept. Inputs in inputs/ were made by refkit itself (prompts below) so the set can be rebuilt.

mug.made_with: existing studio cutout (ceramic mug, stoneware base)

camera.prompt: studio product photo of a vintage 35mm film rangefinder camera, black leatherette body, brushed chrome top plate, knurled dials, three-quarter front view, centred on a plain light grey background, soft even light, no cast shadow

fox.prompt: a small handmade clay figurine of a sitting fox with a curled tail, matte terracotta glaze with white chest, front three-quarter view, centred on a plain light grey background, soft even light, no cast shadow

teapot.prompt: a glossy cobalt blue ceramic teapot with a bamboo handle, front three-quarter view, centred on a plain light grey background, soft studio light with clear specular highlights, no cast shadow
